authorization_scope: Deterministic prospective-v9 semantic adjudication wrapper carried forward unchanged from v4, exact-span and route validation, auxiliary observer, blocked move-and-manner assignment at 84 dialogues over 21 batches, production executor, endpoint, analyzer, one-sided power, and request-validator readiness only; this certificate authorizes no confirmation-model call, live study, or programme-headroom consumption.
launch_gate: v7 keeps what v6 measured and changes three things about how it is tested. First, size: 84 dialogues, 42 per move, seven per move per world, against v6's 36 and 18 and three. Second, direction: the primary is a one-sided exact conditional blocked score test in the direction fixed before any v7 dialogue runs, simplify to one workable step above ask a discriminating question, with the key secondary tested the same way under the same fixed sequence. A result in the other direction cannot reject, whatever its size, and that is the price of the extra power. Third, the manner floor splits in two. v6 held one flag for two facts, whether the tutor delivered the manner it was assigned and whether a reader can tell which manner the turn is in, and failed at 32 of 36 against a single 0.90 floor. From v7 obedience keeps 0.90 and legibility takes 0.80, because the pair is a warm manner against a neutral one and some overlap is built in, and both rates must be reported separately against their own floors. v6 is not rescored under the split and stays closed at failed_interpretability_gate_not_rerun; under the split it would have passed at 0.972 obedience and at least 0.889 legibility and its primary would still have come in at p = 0.0858, so the split rescues nothing. The endpoint, the five-turn window, the trigger rule, the six worlds and the instrument bytes are all carried forward untouched. The instrument earns no fresh accuracy claim: the sealed 55-case held-out v4 corpus is spent and permanently excluded, and its replay here makes no model call. The registration records that at this size the study reaches about 0.59 power in its planning scenario rather than the 0.80 target, and that the 15000-attempt programme safeguard is what sets the size. Launch still requires the wholly fresh digest-bound HOLD request with absent create-once destinations, exact digest verification against the standing authorization, prelaunch verification of the 10332-study and 15000-programme operational safeguards, and a separately committed explicit human approval. The completed v4, v5 and v6 studies, the stopped v2 cohort, and the spent v1-v4 validation corpora remain permanently excluded from every v7 outcome.
